correctness.rationale: PASS for repairs/4/RESULT.md. The frozen exact constant integral is correct, but its equality to 0.5226368151659937... overstates the accuracy of the archived quadrature by about 1.25e-13. Independent SciPy evaluations in two coordinates, and 50-digit mpmath, give 0.5226368151661182760231851559693..., supporting the rounded repair; replay evidence is in branches/65794f39-2759-43f0-b191-6d0a54510829/independent_quadrature.py and independent_quadrature.txt. I reconstructed the proof: adjacent shells are sufficient to test monotone population order and the two endpoint-difference maxima are floor((N-1)/2) and floor((N+1)/2), unchanged from odd N to the following even N; equality remains passive. Activation persists at higher N. The ordered simplex is one of six congruent-in-area permutation sectors, so the uniform density is 12 in (p1,p2). The change to (u,v) has Jacobian u/(1+u+uv)^3; its integral in v over the correctly ordered bounds is the stated difference with factor 6. In log coordinates the scaled interval width tends to 2a and is bounded by 2a, while b>=a/2 gives the integrable envelope proportional to a exp(-5a/2). The trace of the bounded continuous density on the diagonal yields C_f, positive at the required interior positivity; a null Gibbs curve and monotone squeezing yield almost-sure finiteness and the real-t asymptotic. Layer cake gives the positive-moment cutoff. The corrected complete file was inspected; the old finite output is retained only as an archived consistency check. No frozen script was executed.
